lines.zh: 下界地面太碎，我跌着走。
lines.en: The Nether floor is broken; I stumble along.

lines.zh: 我这副高个子，这儿没处放。
lines.en: This tall frame of mine has nowhere to fit here.

lines.zh: 一步跨过岩浆沟，不稳也得走。
lines.en: One stride over the lava ditch, steady or not.

lines.zh: 脚下是荒地，头顶是岩顶。
lines.en: Wasteland below, stone ceiling above.

lines.zh: 我找一块平地，先站住脚。
lines.en: I look for flat ground to plant my feet.

lines.zh: 走路像踩在炭上，烫。
lines.en: Walking here is like treading on coals, hot.

lines.zh: 我的骨头很沉，步子拖得长。
lines.en: My bones are heavy and my steps drag long.

lines.zh: 跌一跤，撞碎半面岩壁。
lines.en: One stumble and half a rock face breaks.

lines.zh: 我沿着同一道岩脊，来回走。
lines.en: I pace the same stone ridge back and forth.

lines.zh: 灰烬打滑，我得靠墙走。
lines.en: Ash slips underfoot; I lean on the wall.

lines.zh: 下界的风是热的，吹得我歪。
lines.en: The Nether wind is hot and bends me sideways.

lines.zh: 再走一段，也许有立足处。
lines.en: A little farther and maybe there is footing.

lines.zh: 站着也难，脚下总在塌。
lines.en: Even standing is hard; the ground keeps giving way.

lines.zh: 我扶着岩壁喘气，气是烫的。
lines.en: I prop against the wall and breathe; my breath scalds.

lines.zh: 这片荒地太亮，红得刺眼。
lines.en: This waste glows too bright, an aching red.

lines.zh: 远处岩浆在响，像有人在呼吸。
lines.en: Lava murmurs far off, like something breathing.

lines.zh: 十五点护甲，挡不住脚滑。
lines.en: Fifteen armor will not stop my feet slipping.

lines.zh: 我等那块石头凉下来再踩。
lines.en: I wait for that stone to cool before stepping.

lines.zh: 高个子在下界是个累赘。
lines.en: Being tall is a burden in the Nether.

lines.zh: 我数脚下的裂缝，数到七。
lines.en: I count the cracks below me, up to seven.

lines.zh: 没有风，只有热浪在推。
lines.en: No wind here, only waves of heat pushing.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，岩顶也在滴水。
lines.en: I stand still while the ceiling drips.

lines.zh: 你这么矮，抬头才看得见。
lines.en: You are so short; I must look down to find you.

lines.zh: 小人，你脚下那块地是稳的。
lines.en: Little one, the ground under you looks solid.

lines.zh: 你身上的火把，借我照路？
lines.en: That torch of yours, could I borrow it for the path?

lines.zh: 你把我看成什么？一根石柱？
lines.en: What do you take me for? A stone pillar?

lines.zh: 下界很少见到你这种东西。
lines.en: The Nether rarely grows things like you.

lines.zh: 你站得真直，是踩到实地了。
lines.en: You stand very straight; found good ground, have you?

lines.zh: 我眼睛在灰里，你找得到吗？
lines.en: My eyes sit in ash; can you find them?

lines.zh: 你站我影子里，灰落你一身。
lines.en: Stand in my shadow and the ash falls on you.

lines.zh: 你举着武器，我先站稳再说。
lines.en: You raise a weapon; let me find my footing first.

lines.zh: 看够了没？我要往前挪了。
lines.en: Looked enough? I am about to shuffle forward.

lines.zh: 你敲我骨头，声音很闷。
lines.en: You strike my bones and the sound is dull.

lines.zh: 十五点护甲，不是白长的。
lines.en: Fifteen armor is not decoration.

lines.zh: 我不躲，躲了会摔。
lines.en: I do not dodge; dodging makes me fall.

lines.zh: 疼，但我还能站着。
lines.en: It hurts; this frame still holds me upright.

lines.zh: 这一下打进灰里，没伤到肉。
lines.en: That sank into ash and never reached flesh.

lines.zh: 我歪了一下，撞塌了石柱。
lines.en: I tip and knock a stone pillar down.

lines.zh: 这一拳在我肋上留了个印。
lines.en: That punch left a mark on my ribs.

lines.zh: 我身上掉渣，早就这样。
lines.en: Bits crumble off me; always have.

lines.zh: 再来，我这身架子结实。
lines.en: Again; this frame holds together.

lines.zh: 痛从骨头缝里冒出来。
lines.en: Pain seeps out from between my bones.

lines.zh: 下界没有饭，只有灰。
lines.en: There is no meal in the Nether, only ash.

lines.zh: 你手里那点吃的，装不满我手心。
lines.en: Whatever you hold is too small for my palm.

lines.zh: 我不挑食，可我抓不住东西。
lines.en: I am not picky, but I cannot grip anything.

lines.zh: 别举了，弯腰要半天。
lines.en: Stop raising it; reaching down takes me half an age.

lines.zh: 这味道被岩浆熏没了。
lines.en: The lava fumes have burned that smell away.

lines.zh: 喂我？我连牙都难对齐。
lines.en: Feed me? I can barely line up my teeth.

lines.zh: 我饿，可我只想吃热的。
lines.en: I am hungry, but I only want something hot.

lines.zh: 你把面包烤一下再拿来。
lines.en: Toast that bread first, then bring it.

lines.zh: 这东西在我嘴里像石子。
lines.en: This feels like gravel in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我跌着追食物，太丢脸了。
lines.en: Chasing food while stumbling is too humiliating.

lines.zh: 你撞我小腿，我差点栽倒。
lines.en: You hit my shin and I nearly topple.

lines.zh: 我这一身硬壳，撞上来不软。
lines.en: This hard shell of mine is not soft on impact.

lines.zh: 你那一推，我踩塌了半块岩。
lines.en: Your shove made me crush half a rock.

lines.zh: 碰一下就掉灰，落你一脸。
lines.en: One bump shakes ash down onto your face.

lines.zh: 我一歪，撞塌了半堵岩。
lines.en: I lurch and knock half a wall of stone down.

lines.zh: 你在我腿边，像根木桩。
lines.en: You stand by my leg like a fence post.

lines.zh: 十五点护甲，碰撞不算疼。
lines.en: Fifteen armor; a bump barely registers.

lines.zh: 借你肩膀扶一下，行吗？
lines.en: May I brace a hand on your shoulder?

lines.zh: 我退半步，你就会掉下去。
lines.en: I step back and you will fall.

lines.zh: 撞完我得重新找平衡。
lines.en: After the knock I must find my balance again.

lines.zh: 下界太大，另一个我太远。
lines.en: The Nether is vast; another of me is far.

lines.zh: 我连站都站不稳，谈什么伴侣。
lines.en: I can hardly stand; what talk of a partner?

lines.zh: 同类见面，只会互相比高。
lines.en: When kin meet, we only compare heights.

lines.zh: 高个配高个，也没地方站。
lines.en: Tall with tall, and still nowhere to stand.

lines.zh: 我这双长腿，走不到相遇处。
lines.en: These long legs will not carry me to a meeting.

lines.zh: 没有小的，只有更多跌撞。
lines.en: No little ones, only more stumbling.

lines.zh: 我的血是灰和火的混合物。
lines.en: My blood is a mix of ash and fire.

lines.zh: 别问这个，我先找个落脚点。
lines.en: Do not ask me that; let me find footing first.

lines.zh: 荒地荒得很，感情也荒。
lines.en: The waste is barren, and so is my heart.

lines.zh: 真有个伴，也只是互相扶着。
lines.en: If I had a mate, we would only hold each other up.

lines.zh: 那块黑石，我捡来垫脚。
lines.en: That black stone, I take it to prop my feet.

lines.zh: 弯一次腰要很久，我慢慢来。
lines.en: Bending once takes ages; I go slowly.

lines.zh: 我指头太粗，捏不起这碎片。
lines.en: My fingers are too thick for this shard.

lines.zh: 捡起来，在岩壁上试硬度。
lines.en: I pick it up and test its hardness on the wall.

lines.zh: 谁掉的骨？我留着当拐杖。
lines.en: Whose bone is this? I keep it as a cane.

lines.zh: 我手里只能拿一块，多了掉。
lines.en: I can hold only one; more will drop.

lines.zh: 这块铁烤得发红，正好。
lines.en: This iron is glowing red; perfect.

lines.zh: 我收着，反正下界没人捡。
lines.en: I keep it; nobody picks things here.

lines.zh: 东西进我手，就沾一层灰。
lines.en: Whatever enters my hand leaves with ash on it.

lines.zh: 我再弯一次，腰要断了。
lines.en: I bend once more and my back will give.

lines.zh: 你踩在实地上，我就盯上你。
lines.en: You stand on solid ground, so I fix on you.

lines.zh: 下界终于来了个站立的东西。
lines.en: At last, something in the Nether that stands.

lines.zh: 我跌过去，也够得到你。
lines.en: Even stumbling, I can reach you.

lines.zh: 目标不大，正好一脚。
lines.en: A small target; one kick will do.

lines.zh: 我十四点拳头，你想试试？
lines.en: My fists hit fourteen; care to test them?

lines.zh: 你脚边的岩块，挡不住我。
lines.en: The rocks at your feet will not stop me.

lines.zh: 我锁住你的热气了。
lines.en: I have locked onto your warmth.

lines.zh: 这地方太窄，你跑不直。
lines.en: This place is too narrow; you cannot run straight.

lines.zh: 我一步一步压过来，别急。
lines.en: I press forward step by step; do not rush.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我，就该动手了。
lines.en: You look up at me; that is my cue.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声先把你吓住。
lines.en: My footsteps are what freeze you first.

lines.zh: 这身骨头追你，绰绰有余。
lines.en: These bones are more than enough to chase you.

lines.zh: 肥的瘦的，我都追。
lines.en: Fat or thin, I chase them all.

lines.zh: 别往岩浆边跑，你会先掉。
lines.en: Do not run by the lava; you will fall first.

lines.zh: 我举起手臂，热浪先过去。
lines.en: I lift my arm and heat arrives before it.

lines.zh: 你后退，我的步子更长。
lines.en: Back away and my stride is still longer.

lines.zh: 我在算落点，别乱动。
lines.en: I am judging where to land; hold still.

lines.zh: 灰落进你眼里，你眨眼了。
lines.en: Ash got in your eye; you blinked.

lines.zh: 这一片地，我踩一脚就碎。
lines.en: One stomp of mine breaks this ground.

lines.zh: 你的心跳撞得岩壁都在响。
lines.en: Your heartbeat rings off the stone walls.

lines.zh: 我不急，反正你没处去。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; you have nowhere to go.

lines.zh: 你举起盾，我就打盾缝。
lines.en: Raise your shield and I strike the seam.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，是假动作。
lines.en: That sway of mine was a feint.

lines.zh: 岩顶这么低，你别跳。
lines.en: The ceiling is low; do not jump.

lines.zh: 你站在亮处，我看得清。
lines.en: You stand in the glow; I see you plainly.

lines.zh: 我压低肩膀，准备撞过来。
lines.en: I drop my shoulder and prepare to charge.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我脚下发抖。
lines.en: Your shadow shakes where it touches my feet.

lines.zh: 再站一会儿，我就到了。
lines.en: Stay a moment longer and I will be there.

lines.zh: 一拳砸下，岩地裂成两半。
lines.en: My fist falls and the stone floor splits in two.

lines.zh: 十四点，够把你掀翻。
lines.en: Fourteen points is enough to flip you over.

lines.zh: 我打偏了，砸进岩浆里。
lines.en: I miss and my fist sinks into lava.

lines.zh: 我手背擦过你，皮就破了。
lines.en: My knuckles graze you and the skin splits.

lines.zh: 骨节撞出火星，你看见没？
lines.en: Bone strikes spark; did you see that?

lines.zh: 这一下我用了半身力气。
lines.en: That blow used half my strength.

lines.zh: 你被扫到，滚了两圈。
lines.en: I sweep you and you roll twice.

lines.zh: 我抬腿踢，动作很笨。
lines.en: I raise a leg to kick; it is clumsy.

lines.zh: 打中你，我自己也站不稳。
lines.en: I land the hit and nearly lose my footing.

lines.zh: 再靠近点，我够不着你。
lines.en: Come closer; I cannot reach you.

lines.zh: 这一拳带火灰，烫得慌。
lines.en: This punch carries ember ash and it stings.

lines.zh: 你躲开，我砸碎了地面。
lines.en: You dodge and I smash the ground instead.

lines.zh: 我的攻击慢，但落得重。
lines.en: My strikes are slow but they land heavy.

lines.zh: 被我这身骨撞一下，够你歇。
lines.en: One hit from these bones will put you down.

lines.zh: 我从灰堆里撑起来。
lines.en: I push myself up out of the ash heap.

lines.zh: 下界荒地多了一个高个子。
lines.en: The Nether waste gains one more tall figure.

lines.zh: 权重一点，我能出现算运气。
lines.en: Weight one; my appearing is luck indeed.

lines.zh: 岩壁裂开，我挤出来。
lines.en: The rock wall splits and I squeeze out.

lines.zh: 脚下先站稳，再抬头。
lines.en: First I steady my feet, then I look up.

lines.zh: 这里太挤，我的肩卡在岩缝。
lines.en: It is cramped; my shoulder jams in the cleft.

lines.zh: 我落地时，灰扬了三丈。
lines.en: When I land, ash billows three yards up.

lines.zh: 又是我，在这个荒地。
lines.en: Me again, in this same wasteland.

lines.zh: 我闻到岩浆，就知道到家了。
lines.en: I smell lava and know I am home.

lines.zh: 这副身子一落地就晃。
lines.en: This body sways the moment it lands.

lines.zh: 我从火里来，往火里去。
lines.en: I come from fire and go back to fire.

lines.zh: 别站在我脚下，我要起身。
lines.en: Do not stand beneath me; I am getting up.

lines.zh: 火对我只是热一点。
lines.en: Fire only makes things a little hotter.

lines.zh: 我从岩台摔下去，骨头响。
lines.en: I drop off the ledge and my bones rattle.

lines.zh: 水浇在我身上，冒白烟。
lines.en: Water hits me and white smoke rises.

lines.zh: 炸得我滚下坡，灰扑一脸。
lines.en: The blast rolls me downhill, ash in my face.

lines.zh: 箭插在骨缝里，我拔不动。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in a bone gap; I cannot pull it.

lines.zh: 这东西绕过我的壳，钻进骨头。
lines.en: It slips past my shell and into my bones.

lines.zh: 饿得我腿更软，站不住。
lines.en: Hunger softens my legs; I cannot stand.

lines.zh: 雷打在我肩上，灰都焦了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my shoulder and the ash chars.

lines.zh: 虚空没有落脚处，我不去。
lines.en: The void has no footing; I will not go.
